title: Cohomological dimension
statement:
For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $T$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the torsion étale cohomological dimension $\kuncd(T)\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}\cup\{+\infty\}$ is the least $d\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ such that $H^q(T_{\Et},F)=0$ for every torsion abelian étale sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and every integer $q>d$, with cohomology as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]; it is $+\infty$ if no such $d$ exists.

For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the torsion étale cohomological dimension $\kuncd(f)\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}\cup\{+\infty\}$ is the least $d\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ such that $R^qf_*F=0$ for every torsion abelian étale sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and every integer $q>d$, where $R^qf_*$ is the higher direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]; it is $+\infty$ if no such $d$ exists.
